title: Indian English + Hindi TTS Speech Dataset
subtitle: 73 min curated single-speaker speech, human-checked transcripts, QC metrics

resources.description: One row per audio clip: human-corrected transcript, language, speaking-style tag, acoustic QC metrics (SNR, LUFS), raw ASR output for WER benchmarking, and full provenance (source URL, license, SHA-256).

fields.name: audio_path
fields.description: Original repo-relative path; on Kaggle use clips/<clip_id>.wav

fields.name: language
fields.description: BCP-47 tag: en-IN (Indian English) or hi-IN (Hindi)

fields.name: emotion
fields.description: Speaking-style tag, LLM-derived from transcript text (conservative; not audio-verified)

fields.name: duration_s
fields.description: Clip duration in seconds (4-18 s design window)

fields.name: sample_rate
fields.description: Audio sample rate, 24000 Hz for all clips

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 hash of the wav file (integrity check)

fields.name: language_probability
fields.description: Language-ID confidence from ASR, where available

fields.name: speaker
fields.description: Speaker/channel identifier; one speaker per language

fields.name: license
fields.description: Source license: YouTube Creative Commons Attribution

fields.name: asr_transcript
fields.description: Raw Sarvam ASR output before human correction (for WER benchmarking)

fields.name: edited
fields.description: True if the human reviewer changed the ASR transcript
